admin.guide.title: Integration guide
admin.guide.lead: How to call places.agent-mate.ai. The agent id is places-agent. Callers send a caller API key. Map-vendor keys stay on the server.
admin.guide.cap_intro: Callers get these tools. HTTP and MCP share the same JSON unless marked HTTP only. Callers pass providers[] as GOOGLE_MAPS and/or AMAP. Search and details cards include sources[].
admin.guide.cap_search_restaurants_body: Find restaurants near coordinates or an address. Optional cuisine, keyword, and open now. Empty matches return errors.empty_results.
admin.guide.cap_search_places_body: Find non-restaurant places (museums, parks, attractions). Same card shape and vendor contract as restaurant search.
admin.guide.cap_details_body: Load one place by provider native_id. Missing places return errors.place_not_found.
admin.guide.cap_geocode_body: Forward-geocode an address or reverse-geocode lat/lng so search can run from a pin or a named area.
admin.guide.cap_navigate_body: Return secret-free map deep links and web URLs for a place or coordinate.
admin.guide.cap_itinerary_body: Build a structured plan from trip bounds, place cards, and preferences. Weather uses Open-Meteo WMO codes via weather.wmo.* keys. Trip screens stay on the caller.
admin.guide.cap_discover_places_body: Search attraction and restaurant candidates for a trip window. Returns up to 8 of each plus weather. Call before arrange_day.
admin.guide.cap_arrange_day_body: Arrange one day from discover_places candidates. Each block includes a reason. Call once per day.
admin.guide.cap_chat_body: Natural-language tool loop. The server runs the same tools. Do not use chat as the only way to search.
admin.guide.cap_tripadvisor_body: Optional ratings and content on HTTP search. Match by name and location. Never pass a Google place_id as a Tripadvisor id. Not an MCP tool argument.
admin.guide.who_apps: App BFFs — what2eat.food and where2play.place, server to server
admin.guide.who_mcp: MCP hosts — Cursor, ChatBox, and similar
admin.guide.provides_3: The same tools on HTTP and MCP
admin.guide.key_body: An admin issues a caller API key in this app. HTTP and MCP use the same key. Send it as:
admin.guide.key_note: A deleted or regenerated secret is rejected. Full secrets are stored for admin Copy from the Keys list.
admin.guide.http_intro: App BFFs call places-agent server-to-server over HTTPS. Keep the caller API key on your backend only — never in browser code, client bundles, or NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables.
admin.guide.http_health_body: Confirm the service is up before wiring tools. A homepage 200 response alone is not enough.
admin.guide.http_endpoints_body: All tool routes use POST with Content-Type: application/json, except health. Send Authorization on every tool call.
admin.guide.http_envelope_body: JSON includes agent (must be places-agent), ok, data, and optional skipped[] entries with provider and reason_key. Missing or invalid keys return errors.caller_unauthorized.
admin.guide.http_providers_body: Use exact ids GOOGLE_MAPS and/or AMAP in each request body. Omitting providers defaults to GOOGLE_MAPS only. Tripadvisor is enrich-only on HTTP search (enrich.tripadvisor) — not an MCP tool argument.
admin.guide.mcp_intro: MCP hosts connect with the same caller API key. Tool names and JSON inputs match HTTP. initialize must return serverInfo.name places-agent.
admin.guide.mcp_cursor_body: Use /mcp for Cursor and other Streamable HTTP MCP clients.
admin.guide.mcp_cursor_file_body: Remote MCP servers in Cursor use url and headers — not command and args (those are for local stdio servers). Paste the JSON below into your project .cursor/mcp.json, or open Cursor Settings → MCP → Edit config. Reload Cursor after saving.
admin.guide.mcp_cursor_env_note: Set PLACES_AGENT_CALLER_KEY in your environment (Cursor expands ${env:…} in mcp.json), or replace the header value with Bearer pa_… literally.
admin.guide.mcp_chatbox_body: Type Remote (HTTP/SSE). Enable MCP tools for the chat. Do not point ChatBox at /mcp — SSE lives at /sse (POST initialize may also use /sse on this server).
admin.guide.mcp_tools_body: Natural-language chat and Tripadvisor enrich are HTTP-only (/v1/chat and search enrich). MCP exposes:
admin.guide.mcp_parity: The same JSON body should return the same card count and skipped[] on HTTP and MCP (Feature 11).
admin.guide.id_note: Callers must see the agent id places-agent (MCP serverInfo.name and HTTP field agent). That string is not localized.
